explication: SONiC is a network operating system with control-plane services and vendor-specific platform support for switch hardware. The sampled runtime illustrates health checks, platform thermal and reboot management, BGP allow-list configuration, authentication, and MLAG link handling. Source excerpts and the index support some internal calls, but do not establish a single end-to-end operator workflow; several capability links are therefore omitted or marked unverified.
